1.consolidated_definition: . Entre campesinos, indica que el hijo varón ha llegado a la edad adulta y ya es capaz de trabajar o halar machete.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Among rural farmers, it indicates that the male child has reached adulthood and is now capable of working or hauling a machete.
